text: Jho'nass is an ogre mage Ogri'la reputation rewards vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Kaja is a tauren bow and gun vendor located in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. After the betrayal of Varimathras and Putress, Sylvanas Windrunner and Forsaken refugees escaped to Orgrimmar. During that time, Orgrimmar was under martial law and Kaja was complaining about the situation along with other citizens. Kaja used to run Boomstick Imports until it was destroyed during the Cataclysm. Without a shop she now resides in the Valley of Wisdom with the other tauren. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Opuno Ironhorn.
__NOTOC__ Kathrum Axehand is a dwarven axe vendor located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Kara Adams is a human shield vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. When the Scourge attacked Lakeshire, she went to fight them.
Karnaze is an orc general goods vendor located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Keeshan's Bow drops from Murdunk in the Redridge Mountains for Weapons of War.

Keep Yer Feet On The Ground begins a quest chain for dwarf characters to obtain their heritage armor. It can be picked up just outside the Stormwind Embassy within Stormwind City after reaching level .
Kilt of Immortal Nature is an epic leather legs armor for druids.
__NOTOC__ Kialon Nightblade is a night elf found in Sylvanaar in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ki'agnuu redeems Tier 16 Normal mode armor tokens for Horde players in Shrine of Two Moons.
__NOTOC__ Kimberly Hiett is a human bow vendor located in the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains. When the Scourge attacked Lakeshire, she went to fight them alongside guards.
King Dorfbruiser is an ogre lord who can be summoned from an Ethereum Stasis Chamber at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Knight-Captain's Leather Armor was part of the old PvP-Rare Rogue set Lieutenant Commander's Vestments and is no longer available in game. It has been replaced by Knight-Captain's Leather Chestpiece of the new Lieutenant Commander's Guard set. Players who had earned this item can use it with the new set and still gain the set bonus however. There are reports that this ability is currently broken.
Koi-Koi Spirits are arakkoa ghosts found in Raven's Wood in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They appear when using an Exorcism Feather on a Raven's Wood Leafbeard during Exorcising the Trees.
__NOTOC__ Kolphis Darkscale can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains. Normally to players, however while Overseer Disguise is worn he'll be .

__NOTOC__ Kohor is an orc warlock and the current leader of the Burning Blade in Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace. He can be found just outside a cave with tunnels that lead underneath the Fortress. After sacrificing both a Horde and Alliance scout Kohor took to threatening and taunting the denizens of both Furien's Post and Nijel's Point to the point that both Sorrem and Captain Pentigast sent adventurers to kill him. In his dying breath, he mentioned that the Burning Blade had a way to summon a powerful demon that would bring about their victory.

__NOTOC__ Kolkar Warmongers are centaur who spawn in Magram Territory in Desolace to help the player defend the :Spear of the Kolkar Khan from Magram Defenders during Delicate Negotiations. They run out of the village and despawn once Khan Kammah appears, as well as if the spear is destroyed and the attack fails.
__NOTOC__ Korgaah is an ogre found in Blade's Edge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Kronk is an ogre mage found at Ogri'la in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Kroga's Blade would be an objective of Far From Invulnerable.
Kuna Thunderhorn is a tauren bow vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.

Legion Fel Cannons MKII are fel cannons located in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Legplates of the Qiraji Command are plate leg armor with a large amount of Strength for warriors and paladins.
Leokk is a wyvern found in Blade's Edge Mountains. He is one of several beasts belonging to Rexxar.
__NOTOC__ Lesser Nether Drakes are nether drakes located in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ley-Keeper's Blade is a quest reward from Arcane Instability (quest).
Lesser Wrath Hounds are summoned by Baelmon the Hound-Master at Death's Door in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Lesser Imps are imps found on Despair Ridge on Mardum, the Shattered Edge and the Lost Temple on the Broken Shore during Vengeance Will Be Ours, and during Legacy of the Icebreaker in front of the Tomb of the Old Kings on Shield's Rest in Stormheim. They also appear in Azsuna. Mother Mirenda summons them at the Shrine of Aviana on Mount Hyjal during Mother's Orders.
Lieutenant Fairweather is a human quest giver located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

.]] Light's Hammer is the entrance hall of Icecrown Citadel, held by the Ashen Verdict. Highlords Tirion Fordring of the Argent Crusade and Darion Mograine of the Ebon Blade, attired in their class' Tier 10 armor, can be found in here, as well as quartermasters and other vendors for the Ashen Verdict. All of the Tier 10 vendors are also located here. Players enter from the north and head south toward and . make incursions from the south and are dealt with by guard NPCs. During the Fourth War, Princess Talanji, Baine Bloodhoof, and a Horde champion used Bwondsamdi's Death Gate to Icecrown and teleported to the chamber, with the Spirit of Vol'jin also accompanying them. The area was deserted,
The Light's Shield Tower is a new scout tower near Corin's Crossing in the Eastern Plaguelands. It was constructed by the Argent Crusade and offers quests and a neutral flight path.
Lightning Shield is a level 9 shaman ability. When attacking or getting attacked, it does direct damage to the target or the attacker.
Light Obsidian Belt is mail waist armor that supplies DPS in the form of increased Attack Power and critical strike chance, as well as increasing all resistances.

Lightning Wasps were level 70-71 wasps that could be found in Bash'ir Landing in northern Blade's Edge Mountains. They could deal 13-427 damage and had normal resistances. Attacking one while in range of an ethereal at Bash'ir Landing will cause the ethereal to aggro.
These are made up of Lightforge Iron and are sought after for their ability to be forged into a weapon to use against Morbent Fel.
The Lightning Lance is a powerful trillium polearm and Wrathion's weapon of choice.

The Lightbreaker is a Legion command ship situated in Felsoul Hold. It belonged to the demon commander Azoran who planned to use it to destroy Dalaran. The portal to the ship was locked by a key halved into two shards which Azoran had given to his two generals, the ered'ruin Vorgos and the jailer Kozak the Afflictor. While the Illidari Lyana Darksorrow held the demonic reinforcements at bay, the order leader who accompanied her crossed the portal and slew Azoran.
Lightning Nova Totem is a totem summoned by Or'Nak in Blade's Edge Mountain in Frostfire Ridge and by Aggar Thunder-Reaver in Frostwall.
Light Hunting Rifle was a quest reward from Rite of Strength (Classic).
Limited Immunity is an armor shop found in the Old Town in Stormwind City.

The Living Grove is a wooded region of southwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, which contains Sylvanaar and Veil Lashh. Lynxes, faerie dragons and treants roam the area, and it is guarded by night elf sentinels.

Logan Palimore is the Caretaker of the Sword and in charge of the upkeep of the Trollbane Family Crypt. He is brilliant at delegation — he feels he doesn’t need to know the information if he knows someone who does. He has assembled the advisory council for the Caretakers and welcomes the eager students who arrive to learn his trade. He is in his sixties and very confident of his skills. He is very sure of his ability to judge character, which he maintains is the most important quality in a Caretaker. Only once has he misjudged a student — a young human male by the name of Ran Tilwood who attempted to rob the artifacts he was supposed to be guarding in Stormwind. Logan banned him from the Car
Lobo can be found inside Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains. It is the companion of Garm Wolfbrother.

A Lodged Hunting Spear is found stuck in a large vine above the southwestern entrance to Thornmire in Tanaan Jungle. Without flying, it can only be reached by climbing a nearby fallen tree and then jumping down on the vine. __NOTOC__
Lord General's Sword is a Level 51 quality One-Handed Sword that has a chance on hit to temporarily increase your attack power.
Lor is an orc stable master located in Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Lorgus Jett was a level 25 rare human member of the Twilight's Hammer in the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. He had a variable spawn point, the earliest of which was in a dead end tunnel just after Gelihast and the last of which was near the first pull of Twilight cultists.

Lorthuna's Gate is a Twilight's Hammer camp located northeast of the Temple of Earth on the lowest shelf of Deepholm. Dragul Giantbutcher leads the Twilight forces at this camp, where they have been mining the nearby jade crystals from the area. Twilight Pyremaws are seen flying above, along with the Alliance gunship Llane's Oath, which can be seen even farther above.
Lost Etin's Strength drops from Tiptog the Lost in the Valley of the Sword in Stormheim.
Lupine Axe drops from Redridge Drudgers in the Redridge Mountains.

Lynxes are red or brown big cats mainly found in Quel'Thalas, but also on the Echo Isles, as well as Netherstorm and the Blade's Edge Mountains in Outland. They are vicious hunters that shred their prey with fang and claw. The springpaw lynxes of the Eversong Woods are known for their high quality pelts, and even night elves have been known to travel to Quel'Thalas just to poach them. The springpaws of Sunstrider Isle succumbed to the influence of the Burning Crystals, forcing the local blood elves to put them down. The wildmane cats of the Echo Isles have been known to prey on the boars that the local Darkspear trolls keep as a food source. The cats' pelts can be fashioned into hefty cloaks
The gronn Maggoc is one of the seven sons of Gruul the Dragonkiller, found patrolling Razor Ridge and Scalewing Shelf in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

.]] once his obsidian armor shatters.]] Magma giants are massive fire elementals that are capable of volcanic eruptions and forging new elementals. The magma giant Lord Rhyolith is one of the most ancient elementals in existence, having been born from the primordial fires that forged Azeroth itself. Aside from the Firelands in the Elemental Plane, magma giants can also be found on the alternate Draenor.

Magram Defenders are centaur who rapidly spawn to attack the :Spear of the Kolkar Khan in Desolace's Magram Territory during Delicate Negotiations. The player needs to hold them off with the help of the Kolkar Warmongers to keep the spear from being destroyed.
Malistar's Defender is an epic caster shield for paladins and shamans.

Mana Shield is a self-cast mage spell that shields the caster from all damage. It can be a mage's best friend or worst killer. When this shield is up, physical and magical damage will be absorbed at the cost of 1 mana per point of damage. The shield collapses after absorbing a set amount or 1 minute passes, whichever comes first.

A consumable item that adds an imbue to a weapon that temporarily increases Mana regeneration and some also increase Healing effects. Most are created with Enchanting. As of patch 3.0, mana oils can no longer be used on any weapon whose Item Level is higher than 165. Additional info: *Wizard Oils - a weapon imbue that temporarily increases Spell damage.
Mana Gathering Staff is sold by Raelis Dawnstar on Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods for .

Manslayer of the Qiraji is a two-handed sword with a generous amount of Strength, Agility and Stamina. This is an appropriate sword for the Warrior class. Paladins also receive a significant benefit from the weapon's stats and speed. While some Hunters may wish to attain the Manslayer, they lack significant benefit from the sword's stat bonus alone.
Mantle of Phrenic Power is epic cloth shoulder armor for casters.

The Mantle of Eternal Victory (also known as the Mantle of the Primus) is one of the pieces of armor that belonged to the Primus. Following the Primus' disappearance, it was somehow obtained by Margrave Gharmal, who stored it in a chest atop their private tower. For unknown reasons, Gharmal did not use the mantle's power against their enemies. The object was recovered by Necrolord Maw Walkers and Alexandros Mograine after Gharmal's death. __NOTOC__
The Massive Iron Axe is a Blacksmithing-crafted two-handed axe with a stamina and strength bonus.
Permanently enchant a two-handed weapon to increase attack power by 55. It also gives your weapon a dripping blood effect.

This wooden, carved mask, typically the size of a small shield, is a focus that many shadow hunters use. These masks provide protection from evil spirits and those seeking to harm the wearer. When a shadow hunter puts on this mask, he gains the ability to see invisible and incorporeal creatures. In addition, the mask protects the shadow hunter from evil spirits, undead and outsiders.
Masterwork Stormhammer is a crafted main-hand hammer made by hammersmiths with a powerful AoE proc.
Matron Li-sahar can be summoned at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains from a Ethereum Stasis Chamber.
__NOTOC__ Matron Varah is a mok'nathal innkeeper located at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Mature Nether Drakes can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Cavern Crawlers are venom spiders found in the caverns to lead from Zangarmarsh into Blade's Edge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Maxnar the Ashmaw is a black drakonid found in Blackwing Coven in Blade's Edge Mountains. He is of the dragonkin, half-man, half-dragon. Maxnar, known as the Ashmaw, is the leader of the Blackwing Wyrmcultists. The druids of Evergrove ask that any able adventurers slay him.

Maximillian's Shield is a quest reward from The Ballad of Maximillian. Notably, it uses the same model as the shields wielded by Stormwind City Guards (and in patch 6.0.2, was updated to match their new armor models), and is thus often sought by roleplayers.
Meminnie was a goblin Arena PvP System rewards vendor located at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains. The Arena Rewards were bought using arena points.
__NOTOC__ Might of the Scourge was a special enchant that was applied to shoulder armor to increase attack power and critical hit chance.
Metalworking Gloves are a leather hands armor which give a slight bonus to strength and stamina.
Permanently enchant a melee weapon to increase spell power by 32. Requires a level 60 or higher item.
Milli's Shield is the only shield in-game that has health regeneration on it.
Mingo is an ogre mage reagent vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Mingo's Fortune Giblets can be bought from Ogri'la Grubgiver in Blade's Edge Mountains in the Ogri'la for for stack of 5.
Mirelle Tremayne is a Forsaken heavy armor vendor located in the War Quarter in the Undercity.

Permanently enchant a melee weapon to do 2 additional points of damage to beasts. Despite the low attack power upgrade, this enchant remains popular because it is the cheapest enchant that provides a weapon glow.
Mish'un, Blade of Tyrants drops from Wrathion, the Black Emperor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Minions of Gurok are earth elemental minions of Gurok the Usurper found just south of Oshu'gun in Nagrand. They're disguised as Shattered Rumblers; throwing Gordawg's boulder at them is capable of breaking the disguise.
Missile is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Mocking blow is a Warrior ability that deals weapon damage and forces a target to attack you for a brief period of time. If you have problems Taunting an enemy off a party member, or don't have time to switch to defensive stance, this may be something useful.
Mithril Heavy-bore Rifle is a gun that increases ranged attack power.
The Mistshroud Shoulders drop from Gorgolon the All-Seeing at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains.

The Mo'arg Incinerator is one of four demons that can be summoned when inserting 35 Apexis Shards into a Fel Crystal Prism at Forge Camp: Wrath or Forge Camp: Terror in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Other possible demon spawns are Galvanoth, Braxxus, and Zarcsin.
Modan is a word in Dwarven which means "mountain": *Khaz Modan *Loch Modan *Bael Modan *Thor Modan See also: *Modani War-Shield
Mo'arg Tormenters are Mo'arg appearing during Shartuul's Transporter event in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

.]] :"Come, you mongrels! Taste the steel of Mogrin's axe!" Mogrin was an orc warrior and faithful messenger for the Horde, known to Warchief Thrall by name. He was entrusted with a crucial report to be delivered to Thrall in Orgrimmar, but was ambushed by quilboars and received a fatal wound, his stomach split open. He found himself being aided by Rexxar, one of the Mok'Nathal, and the surviving Quilboar fled. Mogrin was devastated as he had failed his mission and would die without honor. Rexxar, however, volunteered to deliver the message for him, for the sake of honor. Mogrin was grateful but was unable to tell Rexxar any additional information before dying in the wilds of Durotar.
.]] Molten Armor is a passive level 50 Fire mage ability that increases critical strike chance and reduces all physical damage taken. At level 65, it grants an additional 10% critical strike chance.
Mog'dorg the Wizened is an ogre mage located at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Mok'Nathal Hunters are guards for Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains. When approached by the Alliance, max level versions spawn.
Mok'Nathal Spirits are mok'nathal found in Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Moira's Hammer is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
Mooncloth Leggings is cloth leg armor, useful for casters until they find Tier 0 gear.
Mooncloth Vest is cloth chest armor, useful for casters until they find their Tier 0 chest or better.
This is part of the Moonglade Raiment set, the Dungeon Set 3 armor set for Druids.
This is part of the Moonglade Raiment set, the Dungeon Set 3 armor set for Druids.
This is part of the Moonglade Raiment set, the Dungeon Set 3 armor set for Druids.
The Moon Staff of Elune is a quest reward from Favored of Elune.

Monomania is an achievement earned from defeating High Sage Viryx in Skyreach on Heroic difficulty without killing any of the Shield Constructs. This is fairly easy to do, as all the party must avoid AoE abilities and interrupt the construct when it tries to shield the boss.
Moonpriest's Coronet is an Azerite Armor headpiece that can drop from various rare mobs in Darkshore or can be looted from Sentinel Equipment Cache or Darkshore Cache.
The Moonsteel Broadsword is a Blacksmithing-crafted two-handed sword with a Stamina and Spirit bonus.
Morcrush is a level 68 rare mob colossus who can be found patrolling in eastern Blade's Edge Mountains.
Morkh's Shattered Armor drops from Warlord Morkh in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Moonshadow Staff was added as a reward for the removed quest A Better Ingredient.
Moonstone Weapon had the same effect as the Target Marker (item).
__NOTOC__ Mosswood the Ancient is a Draenor ancient quest giver located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Mossflayer Rogues are undead forest trolls that appear at Light's Shield Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands upon accepting the quest Honor and Strength from Vex'tul.

The Morn'danel was a high elven ship that was sent to evacuate elven children out of Quel'Thalas to the Wildhammer dwarves of the Hinterlands when the Scourge invaded the elven land during the Third War. The lead ship was accompanied by the Fellovar and the Varillian. Soon, gargoyles arrived and overwhelmed all three ships, destroying the Varillian, sending it underwater, and causing the Morn'danel and the Fellovar to collide.
__NOTOC__ Mountainsage Staff is part of a set of equipment provided to Mage characters who used a Character Boost. The rare version of the item was looted from Big Crate of Salvage.
Mugdorg is an ogre mage found in Bladespire Hold in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Mugdorg is one of several leaders of the Bladespire clan.
Mud Splattering Hammer is a quest reward from Rite of Strength.

The Mur'Gul Reaver is a Mur'gul unit used by the Naga as a basic soldier, a step above cannon fodder. Because of their elevated status, we don't know if the Mur'gul Reavers are Mur'gul Slaves trained for war or collaborators who traded their race to the Naga in exchange for continued powers. The Mur'gul Reavers are trained at the Temple of Tides.

Murkimus the Gladiator is a Feat of Strength for acquiring a Murkimus' Little Spear. This pet was originally given out to those who participated in 200 arena matches during the 2009 Arena Tournament, and will also be given to those who participate in 50 matches during the 2010 tournament.
__NOTOC__ Mylini Frostmoon is a night elf weapon vendor located at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.
Nadina Stargem redeems Tier 16 Flexible armor tokens for Horde players in Shrine of Two Moons.
Naga Myrmidons are naga located in the Fel Hammer. They briefly appear once their recruitment is complete.
__NOTOC__ Narianna is a night elf bow vendor located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Natasha is a human located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains. She follows Wildlord Antelarion around the town.
Narzun Skybreaker is a tauren flight master located at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.

The Navigation Console is located on the middle level of the Vindicaar and is used by players as a means of traveling to various points on Argus while aboard the ship. This is accomplished through the unlocking of Lightforged beacons during the Argus quest campaign. It can also be used to have the Vindicaar "docked" in a different zone of Argus, with Krokuun being the default if you arrive from somewhere other than on Argus. When the Vindicaar is infused with the power of the Crest of Knowledge, the console changes color along with the rest of the vessel.
Need an Engine, Take an Engine is the prerequisite quest to Have a Part, Give a Part which spawns the Nesingwary Base Camp flight master, and leads to the Weapon of the Ancients quest chain.
__NOTOC__ Nekthar is an orc found in Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Neferset Armor can be found scattered throughout the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum. They also drop from Neferset Denizens and Neferset Sentinels.

Nemesis is a Twilight's Hammer attempt at creating a dark ancient, their twisted version of an ancient guardian, from which they used Tortolla to do so. While the usurper exists Tortolla cannot reach his full strength. First found roaming the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal, he ends up retreating to the Crucible of Flame when the fire receded. Even after his death echoes of Nemesis keep trying to break through to Mount Hyjal.
Neferset Blade Twisters are tol'vir located in Neferset City in Uldum.

Nethercobra Leg Armor is an armor kit which permanently applies +50 attack power and +12 critical strike rating modifications to leg armor, in the same virtual "slot" as an enchantment. As of Patch 3.1.0 the benefits of this enhancement do not become active until level 60, thus effectively nerfing it for Twinks below that level. Although the enchantment is not removed from your existing item, you will not receive the benefit of this enhancement unless you meet the new level requirements. Thus the new in-game tool tip now shows "Enchantment Requires Level 60" in red font (indicating the enhancement is not active) if your character is below the required level.
Nether Drake Eggs can be found throughout Singing Ridge in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Permanently attach Nerubian Leg Armor onto pants to increase attack power by 55 and critical strike rating by 15. Can only attach to your own armor, and attaching causes the item to become soulbound.

Nemesis Crystals are artifacts in The Crucible of Flame related to Nemesis, the corrupted turtle god created by Twilight's Hammer. A Child of Tortolla examines one with the player during the quest The Strength of Tortolla.
Nether Whelp spawn when a Nether Drake Egg is broken in Blade's Edge Mountains .
Netherstorm Helm drops from Insidion and The Grand Collector in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Nicholas Atwood is a Forsaken gun vendor located in the War Quarter in the Undercity.

Nexus-Prince Shaffar is an ethereal and second nexus-prince to rule in Outland (the others being Nexus-Prince Razaan in Blade's Edge Mountains and Nexus-Prince Haramad, leader of the Consortium). He leads another faction of ethereals in the Mana-Tombs against the Consortium. He is the final boss of Mana-Tombs in Auchindoun.
Nickwinkle the Metro-Gnome is a gnome quest giver located at Toshley's Station in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Nexus-Prince Razaan is an ethereal who runs an operation in the Blade's Edge Mountains involving the collection of souls.
Nizzik is a goblin armor vendor located on the far platform of the Cragpool Lake waterwheel in the Stonetalon Mountains. He was a freewheeling trader friendly to both Alliance and Horde.
Njorndar Spear-Sisters are vrykul located in Jotunheim in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
Northmaul Tower is an ogre-controlled tower in Bloodmaul Outpost in southern Blade's Edge Mountains.
Notched Axe Head is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

O'Mally Zapnabber is a gnome quest giver located in Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He is one of Tally Zapnabber's clones, and bears the codename "Tally's Other Twin". Tally and his other clone, Rally Zapnabber, reside at Toshley's Station.
Obsidian Edged Blade is a two-handed sword with a generous heap of strength and an increase to expertise rating.
Obsidia's Perch is the lair of the black dragon Obsidia, who flies over the Vortex Pinnacle in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

The Obsidian Petroglyph is found at on Blade's Edge Mountain, east of Bladespire Citadel, next to a lava pool. Interacting with it will give the player the Obsidian Frostwolf Petroglyph, which grants a fair amount of rested xp.
Obsidian Tie Event is a collection achievement earned by collecting any armor set from Dragonflight PvP Season 2.

Olaf's All Purpose Shield has a high armor value, and a minor stamina buff. It also has a fun special ability that enables the user to reduce their fall speed for 10 seconds. It is unobtainable by Alliance players, as the Vikings are friendly to the Alliance.
Ogrin is a mok'nathal stable master located in Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ogri'la is an ogre campsite in Blade's Edge Mountains. It is inhabited by friendly ogre magi who offer quests and reputation rewards with their own faction.
Ogri'la Aegis is a reputation reward; you must be with Ogri'la to purchase it for from in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ogri'la Grubgiver is an ogre mage food vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ogri'la Keg King is an ogre mage drink vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Ogri'la Merchant is an ogre mage general goods vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains. In addition to basic general goods, he also sells Brute Cologne. He is the only source of it in the game.
Ogri'la Steelshaper is an ogre mage blacksmithing vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ogri'la Trader is an ogre mage trade goods vendor located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Ogri'la Storyteller is an ogre mage residing at Ogri'la in Blade's Edge Mountains. He will occasionally walk towards the settlement's bonfire, stand at a rock and crystal dais and recite. As he does so, images will appear in the bonfire smoke.
Old Orok is an orc fruit and fungus vendor located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
On the Blade's Edge is a quest achievement earned by completing Blade's Edge Mountains quests.
Orbs of the Grishna drop from the following arakkoa in Blade's Edge Mountains: *Grishna Harbinger *Grishna Falconwing *Grishna Matriarch *Grishna Scorncrow
Or'Nak is an orc located at Blade's Edge Mountain in Frostfire Ridge. She has a totem. When the attacked Stonefang Outpost, Or'Nak killed Kadar.
Orgatha is an orc axe vendor located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

.]] Orgrim's Hammer is the name of the Horde gunship flying over northeastern Icecrown. It replaces the usual ground bases in other zones due to the large Scourge presence on the ground. It sometimes engages in battle against the Skybreaker, the Alliance gunship. So far, neither have been severely damaged, but both are in constant danger of attack from the other and from the Scourge forces on the ground below them. It is named in honor of Orgrim Doomhammer. The latest in goblin zeppelin engineering, the ship is held aloft by two large balloons on either side of it. In order for engineers to service both balloons, and to prevent them from drifting apart, a large metal catwalk links the two to
Orgrim's Hammer Scouts are scouts on dragonhawks flying around, north of Corp'rethar in central Icecrown, scouting the area ahead.
The Ornate Thorium Handaxe is a main hand axe that gives the wielder a bonus to strength.

Ornate Saronite Battlegear is a rare quality plate armor set based around resilience and intellect. It is wholly crafted through the Blacksmithing tradeskill, requiring a minimum of 425 blacksmithing skill to create the entire set. The items of the set require a minimum level of 78 to equip, but have no other requirements (outside of being able to equip plate armor). The resilience afforded by this armor makes it of most interest to plate wearing casters in Player vs Player (PvP) scenarios. The relative availability of the materials required to craft the pieces make it good for fleshing out stats and gear pieces as well. __TOC__

The oscillating hilt is a modification for any straight-blade weapon from a dagger to a greatsword. The blade is removed from its original hilt and placed into a new hilt crafted by tinkers. When a catch in the grip is depressed, a small phlogiston engine built into the hilt's pommel spins the sword's blade at a high velocity, granting the user an increased chance to disarm the opponent. However, as the mechanisms weaken the overall structure of the sword, it becomes softer. The blade inside an oscillating hilt can also be sued as a drill.
The Ornate Weapon rarely drops from selected appropriately-challenging dungeon bosses for players with the Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide in their bags.
Outlaw Sabre was a sword with a nice bonus to Attack Power making it a good weapon for melee classes.
__NOTOC__ Outraged Raven's Wood Sapling can be found in Raven's Wood in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They patrol in groups of three and attack any members of the Wyrmcult they find.

Overseer Nuaar can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains From to to . He patrols a route that starts south east of the Evergrove and finishes north west. He is relatively easy to find by following the route he takes and using the "/target overseer" command. He's an overseer of the Wyrmcult.
The Overseer Disguise is obtained by combining 5 Costume Scraps, dropped by humanoid members of the Wyrmcult in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Pearl-Encrusted Spear drops from Murloc Nightcrawlers at Stonewatch Falls in the Redridge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ The Pauldrons of Imperium (also known as the Pauldrons of the Primus) are one of the pieces of armor that belonged to the Primus. Lady Ouix'Ara of the House of Rituals kept them with her at Death's End and used them as a source of great power until she was defeated by Baroness Draka, Kael'thas Sunstrider, and the Maw Walkers.
The Phase Blade is a Level 55 quality One-Handed Sword that improves Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Phase Wyrms are mana wyrms located at the Bash'ir Landing of Blade's Edge Mountains. They are out of phase with the normal world and are only visible to players who have used a Bash'ir Phasing Device while on Intercepting the Mana Cells† or Maintaining the Sunwell Portal.
A pike is usually described as a pole weapon—a very long thrusting spear used two-handed. Shattered Hand members can attach it as a weapon. The Skardyn favor pikes among a few other types of weapons.

.]] Pirates (also named buccaneers) are seamen and robbers of all races who attack, seize or destroy any ship at high seas. They are also involved in many other illegal activities for their personal interests, such as smuggling, mercenary, kidnapping, slave trading, and assassinations. Therefore they are feared by travelers and merchants for their cruelty, and are the enemies of the Alliance and Horde navies against which they are at war for control of the Great Sea. Many pirates have other synonymous titles, such as freebooters, privateers, corsairs, and raiders. Despite their image as free men, seekers of treasure, with a life full of glory and adventure on the high seas, the life of a pir
Pillar of Ferocity is an epic two-handed staff for feral druids. While arguably the best tanking weapon in the game, it is unfortunately inferior to Stanchion of Primal Instinct for DPSing.
Pixies are demigods resembling minute, sword wielding men with butterfly wings. They helped fight during the War of the Ancients.
__NOTOC__ Plague-Etched Gorer is a quest reward from Here's an Axe, Get to Work!. It also drop from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.
The Plans: Skyforged Great Axe are a quest reward from Clearing the Air. Following the quest, the item is also sold by Lunelli in Shattrath City.
The Plans: Stormforged Axe are a quest reward from Clearing the Air. Following the quest, the item is also sold by Lunelli in Shattrath City.
Plans: Great Earthforged Hammer are a quest reward from Earth to Earth. Following the quest, the item is also sold by Lunelli in Shattrath City for .
Plated Abomination Ribcage is plate chest armor primarily for DPS warriors due to its high amount of strength, and increased critical hit and hit chance.

The Plate of the Damned is massive in form and covered with layers of arcane etchings, yet this imposing armor rests lightly upon the wearer. It was crafted by demons, along with the Helm of Domination, and given to Ner'zhul to make him nearly invulnerable. Along with the Helm, the armor was bonded to Ner'zhul's spirit and locked within the Frozen Throne. Arthas Menethil possessed it at some point.
Plucked Lashh'an Feathers drop from the following arakkoa in Blade's Edge Mountains: *Lashh'an Talonite *Lashh'an Windwalker *Lashh'an Wing Guard *Lashh'an Matriarch
The Plundered Darkscale Blade is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Venture Co. 'Salvage'.
The Plundered Embercrystal Staff is an Island Expedition reward.
Pol Snowhoof is a tauren trade goods vendor located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
The Plundered Swarmer's Blade is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Snowblossom Salvage.

The Plundered Longhunt Bow is an Island Expedition reward. It also has a chance to be rewarded from the following missions: *Treasure Map: Chain of Events *Treasure Map: Giants Treasure *Treasure Map: No Haven
The Plundered Petrified Kelp Blade is an Island Expedition reward.
The Plundered Seacrystal Blade is an Island Expedition reward.

Ponzo's Cream, sold by Ponzo in Loamm for 25x Barter Brick or 10x Barter Boulder, is used to trade for the following recipes from profession vendors around Loamm: *Design: Figurine of the Gathering Storm from Fanilly *Design: Statuette of Foreseen Power from Fanilly *Formula: Enchant Weapon - Spore Tender from Dustmonger Topuiz *Formula: Spore Keeper's Baton from Dustmonger Topuiz *Pattern: Spore Colony Shoulderguards from Garram *Plans: Shadowed Alloy from Kilnmaster Crubus *Recipe: Transmute: Dracothyst from Mistie *Schematic: Polarity Bomb from Scrybbil *Technique: Hissing Rune from Scridorsa the Chiseler *Technique: Vantus Rune: Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible from Scridorsa the Chiseler
Portable Fel Cannons were fel cannons appearing during Shartuul's Transporter event in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They were summoned by Gan'arg Underlings.
Potency permanently enchants a Melee Weapon to add 20 Strength.

A Power Overrun Weapon Enhancement increases a Garrison Follower's weapon item level by 9 points. Note that follower item level is the average of both armor and weapon level, so the actual increase to a follower's item level is only 4.5 points.
Power Realized was a class hall achievement awarded for unlocking 34 Artifact traits, with a single artifact weapon.
Potts' Plates is a heavy armor shop found in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Power Depleted Staff is a rare drop from Expedition Scout's Pack.
Presence of Sight is used on leg and head armor to permanently increase spell power and chance to hit with spells.

Pre-release weapon trainers were weapon masters in the early days of World of Warcraft who taught individual weapon skills. Later, trainers were combined, with a single weapon master in each city who taught all of the skills for that race. With 4.0.1, all weapon skills were given to characters at creation, removing the need for weapon trainers. Many former weapon trainer NPCs are no longer in the game.

The Pride of Tiragarde was a ship that was part of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet destroyed by Horde-controlled red dragons in the Second War. Its shipwreck can be found on the sea floor of the Great Sea. It is named after the Kul Tiran region of Tiragarde Sound.
Primal Mooncloth Shoulders is cloth shoulder armor for priests.
The Protective Hide is an armor shop located in the Old Town district of Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Proto-Nether Drake is created using Temporal Phase Modulator on Nether Whelps that hatch from the nether eggs in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Four Proton Accelerator Controllers can be found within Bash'ir Landing in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Each is next to one end of a Proton Accelerator, a series of aligned rings creating a tunnel-like effect. A Controller requires and consumes an Accelerator Module when activated, which is only purchasable for a short time during the Bash'ir Landing raid event. When used, it attempts to summon . This has a low chance of success, and usually will appear instead. Both drop an Apexis Crystal (item) and can be defeated by a moderate-sized party at level 70. The summoned NPC appears at the far end of the "tunnel", is unattackable, and walks toward the Controller end. It starts out slightly transp
Purified Amethyst can be purchased for from Aether-tech Adept in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
The Pyrewood Armorer is a human armor vendor found at the Blacksmith in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. At night, he transforms into his worgen form as the Moonrage Armorer.

The Pyrewood Leatherworker is a human leather armor vendor found in her house left of the Pyrewood Inn entrance in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. At night, she transforms into her worgen form as the Moonrage Leatherworker.

The Pyrewood Tailor is a human cloth armor vendor found at the Pyrewood Village of Silverpine Forest. At night, he transforms into his worgen form as Moonrage Tailor. He was seen wandering from his house behind the smithy and out in the street in front of the smith and back.
